evidence: Carries the Docs label and directly updates `doc/i2p.md` documentation.
rationale: Fixes inaccurate documentation that misleads users into running incompatible I2P router versions. As noted in the description, `doc/i2p.md` stated that any SAM v3.1 router could be used, whereas Bitcoin Core now relies on leaseSet encryption types introduced in #35696 that require Java I2P ≥ 2.10.0 and i2pd ≥ 2.58.0.
